purpose: Disambiguates derived planning shorthand only. Original adopted source, 96 Unit identities/364 edges, package memberships, B3 full Strategy Lab duties and release slices remain unchanged.
does_not_mean: All 96 Units or all 95 APIs require every Future or non-futures runtime before B3 V1
Future Portfolio S14/S15 becomes production or current B3 release requirement
Mock/DTO/schema identity coverage grants implementation or runtime authority
MVP removes full B3 V1 Strategy Lab obligations

milestone_interpretation.MVP: Original MA10-U03 16-Unit exact dependency closure is retained; mock scope separately authorized and never substitutes qualification.
milestone_interpretation.NORMAL: Rolling source-bound planning spans all 96 original identities; execution scope is selected by exact adopted requirement/Feature release applicability and current grants. Planning membership is not an unconditional current runtime obligation.
milestone_interpretation.COMPLETE_B3_V1: All exact B3_RELEASE_SLICE requirements plus original six journeys, same-version integration and required environment/operator evidence. Future scope remains preserved without implicit promotion or deletion.

PK07_S14_S15.retained: Source-bound original research lineage and future planning; no production strategy admission; does not block original futures/full Lab merely by being in design coverage.

PK07_other_requirements: Portfolio Research/Macro/Bond research requirements retain their distinct FULL_PRODUCT_REQUIRED scope and in_exact_b3_release_slice=false. Do not relabel these as FUTURE_RESEARCH_ONLY or silently delete full-product duties.
